summary: Navigator settings: osc4 (--osc4, terminal colour changing), pass-environment-variable (--penv MY_VAR), set-environment-variable (--senv MY_VAR=42) to pass or set variables inside the execution environment, and pull-policy (--pp: always, missing, never or tag, default tag, which always pulls :latest and otherwise pulls if missing).
questions: How do I pass an environment variable into the execution environment with ansible-navigator?
What pull policies does ansible-navigator support?
How do I stop ansible-navigator from pulling the image every time?
What does pull-policy tag mean in ansible-navigator?

answer_card.title: ansible-navigator pull policy and EE environment variables
answer_card.answer_md:
**pull-policy** (`--pp`, default `tag`):
- `always`: always pull
- `missing`: pull if not available locally
- `never`: never pull
- `tag`: always pull if the tag is `latest`, otherwise pull if missing

**Environment variables in the EE:**
- Pass an existing variable: `--penv MY_VAR`
- Set a value: `--senv MY_VAR=42`
